correctness.rationale: Exact subset-conditioning gives factorial match moments and the complete probability generating function. A two-coordinate transfer changes e_r only via its pair-product; after division by falling factorials the difference is a scaled second-difference of a genuine pgf on n-2 positions. This proves convex order, strict convex-test growth, the stop-loss formula and sharp endpoint laws for every n≥2. The checked exact code independently enumerated 636 degree vectors and 3158 transfer tests, without using finite tests as infinite proof.
